# ==============================================================================
# SECTION 1: R BACKEND DATA PIPELINE & PRE-FILTERING (Runs Once at Build)
# All queries and data shaping live in R/setup.R; this chunk runs it and
# broadcasts the resulting structures to OJS.
# ==============================================================================
source("R/setup.R", local = knitr::knit_global())

# Broadcast In-Memory Data Structures to OJS Space
ojs_define(ojs_movers = movers, ojs_hist = hist_flat, ojs_forecast = forecast_flat, ojs_info = unified, ojs_ebay = ebay_master, ojs_ebay_titles = ebay_title_dict, ojs_metrics = backtest_metrics, ojs_global_stats = global_stats, ojs_churn = daily_churn, ojs_signal_metrics = signal_metrics)
